tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The patient shows marked anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit) with normocytic, normochromic indices, suggesting possible chronic disease or acute blood loss. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is elevated, indicating increased variability in platelet size, which may reflect reactive changes. Leukocyte and erythrocyte counts are within normal limits. Further clinical correlation and investigation into the cause of anemia are recommended.
